PS5 vs Xbox: Where to Buy Digital Games Cheaper

Roundup · Updated 2026-08-05

Both consoles are digital-friendly, but the cheapest place to buy differs by ecosystem. Here's the practical breakdown.

PlayStation 5

  • PlayStation Store — fixed first-party pricing, but regular wallet-credit sales (buy $100 credit for ~$85–90)
  • Key resellers (GMG, etc.) — sometimes beat Store pricing on PSN wallet codes
  • PS Plus — monthly free games and deeper catalog access on higher tiers
PS5 games at GMG

Xbox Series X|S

  • Microsoft Store — frequent "Deals with Gold" and owner discounts
  • Xbox Game Pass — the best value if you play a lot; day-one first-party titles included
  • Key resellers — strong for cross-gen CoD and EA titles
Xbox games at GMG

Cross-platform buying tip

For multi-platform titles like Call of Duty or EA Sports FC, a digital key from a third-party store usually undercuts both console stores. Buy on the platform your friends play on for co-op, but shop the key stores for price.

Where to compare

  • GMG
  • Humble
  • Amazon
